title: How to Setup Stripe Payment Gateway

sections.heading: Overview of Stripe Integration
sections.content: Brilliant Directories includes direct API integration with Stripe for processing recurring membership subscriptions, one-time payments, and digital product sales. Stripe supports credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and SEPA direct debit.

sections.heading: Step-by-Step Stripe Configuration
sections.content:
To connect your Stripe account:
1. Navigate to Finance > Payment Gateways in your admin dashboard.
2. In the 'Active Payment Gateway' dropdown, select 'Stripe'.
3. Click on the 'Credentials' tab.
4. Paste your Stripe Publishable Key (pk_live_...) and Stripe Secret Key (sk_live_...).
5. Configure the Webhook Endpoint URL in your Stripe Dashboard to point to your website webhook URL.
6. Click the blue 'Save Changes' button in the upper right.

sections.heading: Testing and Live Mode
sections.content: You can test transactions before going live by checking the 'Enable Test Mode' checkbox and providing your Stripe test API keys (pk_test_... and sk_test_...). Once verified, switch to Live Mode.

full_text:
Overview of Stripe Integration
Brilliant Directories includes direct API integration with Stripe for processing recurring membership subscriptions, one-time payments, and digital product sales. Stripe supports credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and SEPA direct debit.

Step-by-Step Stripe Configuration
To connect your Stripe account:
1. Navigate to Finance > Payment Gateways in your admin dashboard.
2. In the 'Active Payment Gateway' dropdown, select 'Stripe'.
3. Click on the 'Credentials' tab.
4. Paste your Stripe Publishable Key (pk_live_...) and Stripe Secret Key (sk_live_...).
5. Configure the Webhook Endpoint URL in your Stripe Dashboard to point to your website webhook URL.
6. Click the blue 'Save Changes' button in the upper right.

Testing and Live Mode
You can test transactions before going live by checking the 'Enable Test Mode' checkbox and providing your Stripe test API keys (pk_test_... and sk_test_...). Once verified, switch to Live Mode.
